bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This first-year puppy shots plan sequences doses against gap after last puppy shot, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your dog.

Milestone labels on the first-year puppy shots table (8 weeks; 12 weeks; 16 weeks; ~1 year of age) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished first-year puppy shots puppy series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with forgetting the 1-year booster or daycare card expired, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the first adult DA2PP booster so one reminder system owns the first-year puppy shots week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed first-year puppy shots dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this dog scenario.

Until the first-year puppy shots series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches gap after last puppy shot, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a first-year puppy shots make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next first adult DA2PP booster due date so the same first-year puppy shots miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this first year puppy shots schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual dog.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this first-year puppy shots schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to gap after last puppy shot, and reset reminders as soon as the next first-year puppy shots due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with first adult DA2PP booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that first-year puppy shots booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
